segments.text: And the Word of the Lord said, The generations which are to arise shall not be judged after (the manner of) the generation of the deluge, (which is) to be destroyed, and exterminated, and finally blotted out. Have I not imparted My Spirit to the sons of men, because they are flesh, that they may work good works? But they do works of evil. Behold, I have given them a prolongment of a hundred and twenty years, that they may work repentance; but they have not done it.
And there was repentance before the Lord in His Word that He had made man upon the earth. And He said, and judged in His heart.
But Noah, because he was righteous in his generation, found favour and mercy before the Lord.
And the earth was filled with violences and frauds.
